entries.title: Philippians 1:1
segments: ¶Paul and Timothy, bondservants of Jesus Christ, To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

entries.title: Philippians 1:2
segments: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philippians 1:3
segments: ¶I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

entries.title: Philippians 1:4
segments: always in every prayer of mine making request for you all with joy,

entries.title: Philippians 1:5
segments: for your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now,

entries.title: Philippians 1:6
segments: being confident of this very thing, that He who has begun a good work in you will complete [it] until the day of Jesus Christ;

entries.title: Philippians 1:7
segments: ¶just as it is right for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart, inasmuch as both in my chains and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you all are partakers with me of grace.

entries.title: Philippians 1:8
segments: For God is my witness, how greatly I long for you all with the affection of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philippians 1:9
segments: ¶And this I pray, that your love may abound still more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

entries.title: Philippians 1:10
segments: that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense till the day of Christ,

entries.title: Philippians 1:11
segments: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which [are] by Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

entries.title: Philippians 1:12
segments: ¶But I want you to know, brethren, that the things [which happened] to me have actually turned out for the furtherance of the gospel,

entries.title: Philippians 1:13
segments: so that it has become evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my chains are in Christ;

entries.title: Philippians 1:14
segments: and most of the brethren in the Lord, having become confident by my chains, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

entries.title: Philippians 1:15
segments: Some indeed preach Christ even from envy and strife, and some also from good will:

entries.title: Philippians 1:16
segments: The former preach Christ from selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my chains;

entries.title: Philippians 1:17
segments: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.

entries.title: Philippians 1:18
segments: What then? Only [that] in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is preached; and in this I rejoice, yes, and will rejoice.

entries.title: Philippians 1:19
segments: For I know that this will turn out for my deliverance through your prayer and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Philippians 1:20
segments: according to my earnest expectation and hope that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

entries.title: Philippians 1:21
segments: ¶For to me, to live [is] Christ, and to die [is] gain.

entries.title: Philippians 1:22
segments: But if [I] live on in the flesh, this [will mean] fruit from [my] labor; yet what I shall choose I cannot tell.

entries.title: Philippians 1:23
segments: For I am hard pressed between the two, having a desire to depart and be with Christ, [which is] far better.

entries.title: Philippians 1:24
segments: Nevertheless to remain in the flesh [is] more needful for you.

entries.title: Philippians 1:25
segments: And being confident of this, I know that I shall remain and continue with you all for your progress and joy of faith,

entries.title: Philippians 1:26
segments: that your rejoicing for me may be more abundant in Jesus Christ by my coming to you again.

entries.title: Philippians 1:27
segments: ¶Only let your conduct be worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your affairs, that you stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel,

entries.title: Philippians 1:28
segments: and not in any way terrified by your adversaries, which is to them a proof of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

entries.title: Philippians 1:29
segments: For to you it has been granted on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for His sake,

entries.title: Philippians 1:30
segments: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear [is] in me.
